target.title: test(boolean): unit tests for asBoolean and parseBooleanValue
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`asBoolean` and `parseBooleanValue` in `src/utils/boolean.ts` are used at config, env, and plugin SDK boundaries to normalize boolean-like inputs. Existing coverage in `utils-misc.test.ts` has only 4 shared test cases (11 assertions) with no dedicated test file.

## Why This Change Was Made

`parseBooleanValue` delegates to `@openclaw/normalization-core` string coercion (trim + lowercase), which creates non-obvious behavior: case-insensitive matching, whitespace tolerance, and custom list precedence. Without dedicated tests, regressions in the normalization chain or list-configuration path could silently break boolean parsing.

## Changes

- **`src/utils/boolean.test.ts`** (new, 102 lines) — 16 test cases (42 assertions) covering both functions exhaustively

## Evidence

Test output from `npx vitest run src/utils/boolean.test.ts`:

```text
 ✓ src/utils/boolean.test.ts (16 tests) 4ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  16 passed (16)
```

### asBoolean (5 tests)

| # | Test | Assertions |
|---|------|:--:|
| 1 | returns boolean values as-is | 2 |
| 2 | returns undefined for string look-alikes | 2 |
| 3 | returns undefined for numbers | 2 |
| 4 | returns undefined for null and undefined | 2 |
| 5 | returns undefined for Boolean object wrappers | 2 |

### parseBooleanValue (11 tests)

| # | Test | Assertions |
|---|------|:--:|
| 6 | returns booleans as-is | 2 |
| 7 | parses default truthy strings | 4 |
| 8 | parses default falsy strings | 4 |
| 9 | handles case-insensitivity | 6 |
| 10 | handles whitespace trimming | 5 |
| 11 | returns undefined for ambiguous/unsupported strings | 3 |
| 12 | returns undefined for non-boolean, non-string values | 5 |
| 13 | respects custom truthy/falsy lists | 3 |
| 14 | returns undefined with empty lists | 2 |
| 15 | prioritizes truthy over falsy on conflict | 1 |

## Related

N/A (self-contained test addition)
